definitions.explanation: The highest point of a road crossing mountains.
The most critical or intense point of something.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}の{峠|とうげ}を{越|こ}えた。
examples.english: The illness passed its crisis point.

notes:
LITERAL MEANING:
- The highest point when crossing a mountain
- {山道|やまみち}の{峠|とうげ} (mountain pass)

FIGURATIVE MEANING:
- The most critical or turning point
- {病気|びょうき}の{峠|とうげ} (crisis point of illness)
- {仕事|しごと}の{峠|とうげ} (peak of work)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {峠|とうげ}を{越|こ}える: to pass the peak/get over the worst
- {峠|とうげ}を{越|こ}す: same meaning, variant form
- {峠|とうげ}{道|みち}: mountain pass road

KANJI NOTE:
{峠|とうげ} is a Japanese-made kanji ({国字|こくじ}): {山|やま} + {上|うえ} + {下|した}.
